keyVerseDR: "If any man desire to be first, he shall be the last of all and be minister of all." (Mk 9:34 DR)

level1.title: Be Like a Child
level1.story: The disciples argued about who was the greatest. Jesus took a little child in His arms. He said, "Whoever welcomes a child like this welcomes Me."
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you let others go first?

activity.title: Servant badge
activity.intro: Whoever wants to be first must serve. Color your badge.
activity.label: Servant of all

level2.title: Who Is the Greatest?
level2.story: Jesus taught His disciples that He would be killed and rise again, but they did not understand. On the way, they argued among themselves about who was the greatest. Jesus sat down and said, "If any man desire to be first, he shall be the last of all, and the minister of all." Taking a child, He set him in their midst and embraced him. Jesus said, "Whosoever shall receive one such child as this in My name, receiveth Me."
level2.keyLine: If any man desire to be first, he shall be the last of all.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus use a child as an example?
Where do you want to be 'first'?
level2.prayer: Jesus, teach me to be servant of all. Amen.

activity.title: A secret good deed
activity.intro: Fold it closed. Do this in secret, then open after.
activity.question: What secret good deed will I do to serve someone this week?
activity.answer: Jesus sees what is done in secret. Thank you for serving like Him!
